**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (deviation requiring insert), confidence 0.9.**

- **Investigation:** Full-text searches for "insurance", "insured/coverage/policy", and "workers compensation / certificate / at its own expense" returned no hits. All three planner candidates were read: §14.12 Risk of Loss only allocates risk of loss between Base and Customer Components; §5.3 Security describes security options and disclaimers with no coverage undertaking; §14.8 Personnel addresses supervision and subcontracting. §14.18 Data Protection confirms IBM processes personal information on our behalf as part of the Services, and §5.3 confirms it hosts the e-business Hosting Environment — a data-touching services/hosting vendor with zero insurance, i.e. walk-away territory.
- **Target level:** preferred, since the clause is genuinely absent and inserting the full package costs no more than a partial one.
- **Cure:** one `insert_after` at the end of the Notices operative text as new §14.21, carrying only the six checklist elements. I omitted the model language's "at its own expense" and the one-year survival tail as non-element boilerplate.
- **Direction/scope care:** "Customer Data" is not a defined term in this Agreement, so the cyber trigger reaches "any data belonging to, supplied by, or processed on behalf of Customer" rather than a narrow list of examples. Numbering follows §14.20 to avoid a collision, and no existing text was altered.
